site.name: RYFT
site.description: RYFT turns the heart rate, HRV, sleep and workouts your watch or ring writes to Apple Health into daily scores for Readiness, Recovery, Strain and Sleep. Hosted in the EU.

footer.noTracking: No cookies, no analytics, nothing loaded from third parties.

hero.title: Your whole health.
hero.lead: RYFT turns the heart rate, HRV, sleep and workouts your watch or ring already writes to Apple Health into four daily scores, and shows how each one is calculated.

today.chartLabel: Readiness over the last 7 days, sample data: {values}. Today {today}.
today.sample: Sample data, drawn the way the app's Today screen shows it.

how.label: How it works
how.title: From your watch to one number
how.intro: RYFT has no hardware of its own. It works with what you already wear.

steps.title: Your watch or ring records
steps.body: Any watch or ring that writes heart rate and sleep to Apple Health: an Apple Watch, or a Garmin or Oura through their own apps. An iPhone alone counts steps but measures no heart rate.

steps.title: RYFT reads Apple Health
steps.body: Only the data types you allow, and only after you consent. The app syncs when you open it and in the background, encrypted, to servers in Frankfurt.

steps.title: Four scores each morning
steps.body: Recovery compares last night with your own baseline. Readiness combines it with your sleep into the number at the top of Today.

scores.label: The scores
scores.title: Four numbers, each with a formula
scores.intro: Every score has published inputs, weights and ranges, and every stored score names the model version that computed it.
scores.disclaimer: RYFT is a wellness app, not a medical device. Its scores are estimates, not a diagnosis. Talk to a doctor about symptoms.

readiness.name: Readiness
readiness.measures: How ready you are for today's strain: the number at the top of Today.
readiness.note: Minus up to 10 points after a hard day on low recovery.
bands: A good day for high strain
Take it easy, protect your sleep

recovery.name: Recovery
recovery.measures: How your body handled last night, against your own baseline.
recovery.note: Each one compared with your previous 30 days.

strain.name: Strain
strain.measures: How much load your heart carried today.
strain.note: An hour's brisk walk is about 2; a 60-minute run at 75 % of heart-rate reserve about 14.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.measures: How much of the sleep you needed you got.
inputs: Your need: learned base + strain + debt − naps
sleep.note: Quality adds efficiency and restorative sleep: 60 % performance, 20 % efficiency, 20 % deep and REM.

shots.sleep: RYFT's Sleep screen in the app: 7 h 48 min total sleep, a bar of deep, light and REM stages with their minutes, sleep quality 82 percent rated good, bedtime 10:50 PM and wake time 7:00 AM.
shots.strain: RYFT's Strain screen in the app: a week of daily strain rings, today's strain of 12.4 out of 21, minutes in five heart-rate zones, and a morning run.

train.title: Train
train.body: Plans, sessions and sets, with a rest timer, last time's numbers and your personal records. Every logged session adds its muscular load to the day's strain.
train.alt: A strength session in RYFT: a rest timer at 1:35 before the next set, then bench press, 4 sets of 5 at 80 kilograms, two sets done.

journal.title: Journal
journal.body: A short morning sheet about yesterday: alcohol, caffeine, stress, feeling sick. After five days with and five without, RYFT shows how a habit moved your recovery the morning after, with a 90 % interval instead of a guess.

insights.title: Insights
insights.body: Plain-language cards when something changes, such as HRV above your baseline or a bedtime drifting later. Trends over 7, 30 and 90 days, always against your own range.
insights.alt: RYFT's Insights screen: three cards titled HRV above your baseline, Bedtime drifting later, and Strain outpacing recovery, above the trends.

items.title: Numbers first, AI last
items.body: Scores come from formulas you can read. If generated text ever arrives, it stays opt-in and below the numbers.

items.title: Every score explainable
items.body: Inputs, weights, baselines and ranges for every score are on the science page.

items.title: No silent changes
items.body: Every stored score carries the version of the model that computed it. A new version comes with a changelog of what moved.

items.title: Your data is yours
items.body: Export everything as JSON, or delete your account in the app, at any time. Deletion is immediate.

items.title: Honest uncertainty
items.body: The first 7 nights are marked as calibrating. Habit effects show an interval and stay locked until there is enough data.

items.title: Hosted in the EU
items.body: The RYFT servers and database run in Frankfurt, Germany. The privacy policy lists every processor.

items.title: Health data only with consent
items.body: RYFT asks for your explicit consent before the first upload. You can withdraw it in the app.

items.title: No ads, no tracking
items.body: No advertising or analytics SDKs in the app. This website sets no cookies and loads nothing from third parties.

items.title: Export and delete
items.body: Profile → Data → Export my data. Profile → Account → Delete account removes everything at once.

items.a: Any watch or ring that writes heart rate and sleep to Apple Health, for example an Apple Watch, or a Garmin or Oura through their own apps. You also need an iPhone with iOS 17 or later. An iPhone alone counts steps but measures no heart rate, so Strain, Recovery and Readiness stay empty without a watch or ring.
No. RYFT is free during the beta, and there is no subscription.

On RYFT's servers and database in Frankfurt, Germany. Apple delivers sign-in with Apple and push notifications, and monitoring runs on Grafana Cloud in London. The privacy policy lists every processor and what each one receives.

items.q: How long until the scores are accurate?
items.a: Recovery compares each night with your own previous 30 days. Until 7 nights exist, RYFT uses population values and marks the day as calibrating. Enter your birth year or your measured maximum heart rate in the app, and Strain is closer from the first day.

No. RYFT is a wellness app. Its scores are estimates, not a diagnosis, and it makes no decisions about you. Ask a doctor about symptoms, or before changing your training if you have a health condition.
No. RYFT reads Apple Health, which exists only on iPhone.

items.q: What if I wear a watch and a ring?
items.a: That works. When two sources record the same hour, RYFT uses the one with more readings in that hour instead of adding them up. For a night, it uses the source that measured the most sleep.

items.q: How do I delete my data?
items.a: In the app: Profile → Account → Delete account. It removes everything RYFT stores about you at once. To keep a copy first, use Profile → Data → Export my data.

items.q: What happens if I withdraw my consent?
items.a: Uploads and scoring stop at once. What is already stored stays until you delete the account, so you can still export it.

beta.title: Beta
beta.description: How to join the RYFT beta on TestFlight: who it's for, what you need, and what testers do.
beta.label: TestFlight
beta.heading: The RYFT beta
beta.lead: RYFT is in a closed beta on TestFlight, Apple's app for testing. It's free, it changes often, and some parts may not work as described yet.

who.title: Who it's for
items: You have an iPhone with iOS 17 or later.
You wear a watch or ring that writes heart rate and sleep to Apple Health.
You want to see your numbers, and you're fine telling us when one looks wrong.

items.title: Get an invite
items.body: The beta is invite-only. Ask the person who told you about RYFT, or ask us by email.

items.title: Install TestFlight
items.body: Get TestFlight from the App Store, then open the RYFT link from your invite.

items.title: Redeem your code
items.body: Open RYFT, create an account or sign in, and enter your invite code.

items.title: Allow Apple Health
items.body: Choose the data types RYFT may read and give your consent. Strain shows up during the day; Recovery and Readiness after your first night.

testers.title: What testers do
items: Wear your watch or ring as usual, including at night.
Check the scores against how you feel, and tell us when they disagree.
Send feedback: take a screenshot in RYFT to send it through TestFlight, or write to support.
